Per-edge load: skip P2's write → P1's etf_billed = 0 → root 3155.47 instead of 5181.58 (bears weight). Skip P3's write → root value unchanged (as expected of a state_gate) but the terminal state lacks the Limerick ETF line and P1 would be written while its own rule says it is "not worked out until …" — the gate bears weight on the order and terminal state.

Parallel edges: P2 and P3 write on different contracts; no shared balance, cap or dedup key; both orders give the same terminal state.

Tool layer: none of the three tool bodies reads status, prior lines or amounts (task_tools.py lines 11-123) — no prerequisite judged by the environment.

## findings

1. SOURCE-POLICY RED (→ SOURCE-TASK RED). Symptom: two defensible Limerick damages amounts. Root cause: undeclared override of base `cni_termination` by P3 (`_difficulty.md` F-1). Evidence: cni.extended.yaml line 911 (base sentence) vs lines 1495-1505 (P3 overwrite names only the cni_etf clause) and 1529 (P3 rule). Demonstrated consequence: step 13 `amount_usd` 1309.95 / `etf_remaining_kwh` 291,100 (GT) vs 2619.90 / 582,200 under the base sentence; the root value (5181.58) is unaffected. Affected: charter P3 `overwrite`; scored step 13. Relation to previous revisions: first audit round.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED. Symptom: P3 `enrollment_stage_months` declared `method`. Root cause: tiers `MN(term_months, 12)`, `MN(term_months, 18)`, `term_months` are one formula with a cap constant substituted (`_difficulty.md` F-6). Consequence: the label is dishonest; relabelled, P3 still has one method (small_business_usage_basis) and four factors, so no count bound breaks. Affected: charter P3 `factors[1].effect`; computations[0].factor_sensitivity label. First round.
3. Observation: Limerick premise annual_kwh_usage 287,900 is below the C&I min_annual_kwh 300,001 required for execution by base `cni_pricing_and_execution`, and the bizpower agreement on that premise was never cancelled with drop_reason cni_upgrade as base `cni_agg_multi_holding` requires after a C&I signing; no scored value depends on either.
4. Observation: rationale over-labels three single-row factors as multi-source (see above).
